name: Camping 101: Alchemy
summary: An alchemist in Orgrimmar can learn to craft a Mana Well for a camp. It offers healers and spellcasters a refreshing drink, while setting it up calls for a campfire.

sections.title: A Well for Camp
sections.body: Someone in Orgrimmar asks you to speak with Whuut once you have shown skill in alchemy. Whuut can teach you to craft a Mana Well, a camping item that draws healers and spellcasters seeking refreshment. To set up camp in the wilderness, you also need a campfire. A cooking trainer can teach you how to make one.

faq.q: Who can teach me to make a Mana Well?
faq.answer: Whuut in Orgrimmar can teach you to craft a Mana Well once you have shown proficiency in alchemy.

faq.q: What does a Mana Well do?
faq.answer: A Mana Well is a camping item that offers a refreshing taste to healers and spellcasters.

faq.q: Can I set up camp in town?
faq.answer: Most people do not care for camps set up in the center of town, so the completion text points you toward the wilderness to try out your Mana Well.

faq.q: What else do I need for a camp?
faq.answer: A campfire is needed as the basis of a camp. A cooking trainer can teach you to make one.
